metadata.title: Bicolor Wig Portrait with Distorted Features

retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait featuring a split black-and-white wig and facial distortion via clear tape against a void-like black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, centered portrait of a person wearing a blunt-cut wig that is vertically split into black and platinum blonde halves. The subject's face is distorted using clear adhesive tape, pulling the nose and mouth into an exaggerated expression, while hands reach in from the sides to grip the hair. The entire scene is set against a deep black, non-reflective background with a single line of scratchy, hand-drawn white text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bisection of the subject via the black and white wig
Symmetrical placement of hands framing the head
Contrast between the smooth wig texture and the distorted skin
Isolation of the subject against a total black void
Alignment of the text centered above the head
coreInvariants: The wig must be exactly half black and half platinum blonde
The background must be solid black with no visible horizon line
Facial features must be visibly altered by clear tape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The head and shoulders are centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the taped nose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the distorted face, move up to the hands gripping the hair, and finally to the white text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subject, particularly at the top and sides.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Platinum Blonde (half of wig and text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Flesh tones and pink (tongue and skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white hair/text and the black background; low saturation in the skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to black, white, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Scratchy, jittery strokes resembling hand-drawn ink
Variable line weight with intentional imperfections
Small arrow-like serifs or ticks at the ends of strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a crossbar that extends beyond the vertical stems
The letter 'S' is composed of sharp, angular segments
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone expressive lettering to maintain focus on the image.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, scratchy energy of the original text
Captures the irregular line weights and jittery edges

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with a blunt-cut wig split vertically (left side black, right side platinum blonde). Use clear tape to distort the nose and mouth. Place hands on the head as if pulling the hair. Set against a solid black background with dramatic lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn white lettering in a scratchy, jittery style at the top center of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the wig perfectly split into black and white halves?
Is the face visibly distorted by clear tape?
Is the text white and scratchy in appearance?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing artist names or specific album titles
Avoid replicating specific tattoos on the arms
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the split in the wig is a sharp vertical line
Verify the tape looks like clear adhesive on skin
Check that the text is legible but maintains a raw, hand-drawn feel
Confirm the background is deep black without noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered portrait + Bicolor split wig + Facial distortion (tape) + Black void background + Scratchy white display text.
